caption_en:
Evil Israel blockades Gaza. Watch. 🚚

Ceasefire deal, Oct 2025: 600 aid trucks a day (Reuters). COGAT: about 1.78 million tons of food entered from 10 Oct 2025 to 7 Jun 2026. 1,780,000,000 kg ÷ 241 days ÷ 2.1 million people (PCBS) ≈ 3.5 kg per person, per day (our math on COGAT's figures; UN counts are lower, covering UN channels only).

HAMAS on civilians: "It is the responsibility of the United Nations to protect them." (Mousa Abu Marzouk, RT, Oct 2023, MEMRI)

Polio, Sept 2024: 9 hour daily pauses, 558,963 kids vaccinated (WHO, UNICEF). Water: first pipe reopened 15 Oct 2023. Power: a line to Deir al-Balah's desalination plant reconnected Nov 2024 (cut again Mar 2025). Egypt: Rafah open 36 days in 2017 (OCHA), though Egypt also sent aid.

Photos: U.S. Army and U.S. Air Force (public domain); IDF (CC BY-SA 2.0); Mattes (public domain, illustrative); J. J. Badwan (CC BY-SA 4.0); via Wikimedia Commons. AI voice.

Send this to someone who says blockade.
caption_he:
ישראל המרושעת מטילה מצור על עזה. תראו.
600 משאיות סיוע ביום לפי הסכם הפסקת האש. כ־1.78 מיליון טון מזון עד יוני 2026 (מתפ"ש) = כ־3.5 ק"ג לאדם ליום. חיסוני פוליו ל־558,963 ילדים, מים, חשמל. ומצרים? רפיח היה פתוח 36 ימים ב־2017.
זה לא מצור. זו חסות. לתושבי עזה מגיע יותר מחמאס.

lines.line: Trucks. More trucks. Even more trucks.
The ceasefire deal: six hundred aid trucks a day.
By June: one point seven eight million tons of food.
How much is that per person?
About three and a half kilos. Per person. Per day.
Why? Because HAMAS, their own government, says this.
It is the responsibility of the United Nations to protect them.
So evil Israel paused the fighting. Nine hours a day.
And over half a million kids got polio vaccines.
Water? A pipe reopened one week into the war.
Power? A line to Gaza's water plant, reconnected.
Yes. This is how Israel blockades Gaza.
Oh, and Egypt blockades Gaza too. Rafah, in twenty seventeen? Open thirty-six days.
That is not a blockade. That is sponsorship.
Many countries would love to be blockaded like this.
So yes. Evil Israel blockades Gaza.
